name: Jabesh
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy

points: Shallum the son of Jabesh conspired against him and smote him before the people. That is a public assassination, a public execution, and then he reigned in his stead.

“Shallum the son of Jabesh conspired against him, and smote him before the people, and slew him, and reigned in his stead.” He took over. You had mutiny, constant mutiny, in the Northern Kingdom, numerous times.

note.label: Gentiles: What Happened to Northern Kingdom?
